title: Wertheim theory for one-patch spheres: supporting code and data for Li et al. 2016
description: Retrospective (2026) reimplementation of the Wertheim integral-equation calculations in Li et al., J. Phys. Chem. B 2016, 120, 8953, with values digitized from the article's figures. It is not the original 2016 code and was not part of the peer-reviewed article. Code is under MIT; data, results and figures are under CC BY 4.0. See NOTES.md for what reproduces, what does not, and two misprints in the article's equations.
